scope: QA-03 lost station reference and curved route timing/pose continuity

lostStation.change: A train that has paid for and entered a segment remains visible at the saved track position when its departure station disappears.
lostStation.destinationStationTest: DestinationStationLossStopsPaidSegmentAndResumeDoesNotChargeAgain passed: the route stopped, then resumed from the paid position without a second fuel debit after the same station reference returned.

before.pointOneSecondTicks: Moving at stop 1, progress just below 20, revision 0

curveAndTiming.change: Snap sub-nanosecond dwell/segment remainder at boundaries; interpolate the train pose from departure station through track cells to arrival station over the existing segment duration.

limits: Station loss was simulated by removing the runtime station building in an isolated Play session; no player save was modified.
Curve/timing checks used the authored scene and runtime pose, but did not drive physical mouse input or a standalone build.
